detailed_save_gate: All 8 pre-period primary p-values finite and >= .05; 2023 total finite, negative, p < .05.
stop_rule: Stop immediately on nominal pattern_match among gate-passing cases; preferred_match is optional.
fixed: Same anchor model types, timing, dose, outcome, size, baseline, alpha, seed, gap, finite difference, sample reference; all new bootstrap1999. Old variable anchors had999.
sample_note: Full reference union filters cases in each timing design. Baseline/current covariates and support can change the realized sample; hashes are retained for accepted cases.
retention: All candidates and attempted dispositions retained; rejected detailed outcomes removed. Only accepted cases get detailed estimates/figures.
inference_note: Outcome-guided exploratory local search, frozen before new outcomes; Bonferroni is reported but cannot undo selection or establish causal identification.
anchor_selection: Gate-passing cases only; descending core flags (5), descending nondecreasing post-year transitions (6), descending positive SME2025 indicator, ascending nominal SME2025 p, ascending suite/run ID. Select ten; twenty neighbours each.

domains.local: One or two active coordinates per normalized anchor; ten single and ten paired neighbours per anchor.
domains.variable: One feature added or removed per variable coordinate; GPS pool13, Mu pool18; minimum2.
domains.support: ESS +/-1, trim +/-.025, density +/-.001, bandwidth +/-.05 within explicit bounds.
domains.model: GPS knot/degree +/-1; same Mu type, trees +/-40, depth +/-1, LR +/-.01, row/column +/-.05; ridge alpha /2 or *2.
domains.industry: refined group/observation threshold +/-1, or dummy toggle; scheme unchanged.
